column1: Gulong.ph Ads & Sales Forecast | August Baseline to December 2026

Forecast basis: August 2026 actual performance is the baseline. Planned PMax daily budget increases monthly: ₱1,000 in September, ₱1,100 in October, ₱1,200 in November, and ₱1,300 in December. Overall funnel targets are aligned to the sales goals (₱11M, ₱12M, ₱13M, ₱14M+). A separate Search budget of ₱500/day is included in monthly capacity. September total is shown as ~₱157K projected because the higher budget did not run from September 1.
